method: Nearest OSM locality centre with matching BHK median, within 2 km of ward representative point. Locality proxy, not measured ward rent.

inference.method: Gaps use up to three nearest locality medians of the same BHK. Inverse squared distance weights, distance floor 500 m; rounded to ₹500. Not a market valuation or a measured ward median. Beyond 5 km to nearest source is flagged as long-distance extrapolation. No housing-type or furnishing adjustment.
